amendments.summary: Expanded verified_by and approved_by to accept 'claude' (full delegation for non-governance authored proposals). Governance still human-only.
amendments.authorized_by: the operator via direct chat delegation

amendments.summary: Promoted Roux to asymmetric verifier: verified_by='roux' accepted ONLY when status='fail' (not 'pass'). Evidence-based: 12/12 (100%) on fabrication detection vs 70% on legitimate-PASS judgment. Governance still human-only.
amendments.authorized_by: the operator via captain-shift chat delegation

amendments.summary: Governance-relevance routing: when a proposal is governance-relevant (author=roux_reflection, or touches Roux's runtime paths, or contains specified keywords), shadow verification bypasses Roux and goes directly to bigbrain (Claude/Sonnet). Addresses documented n=4 self-protective confabulation pattern where Roux defensively FAILed proposals critiquing her own behavior.
amendments.authorized_by: the operator via direct chat delegation

source_url.validation: non-empty; if startswith '/' or '~', file must exist on disk

scope_restrictions.roux: may only attest status='fail', not 'pass' (asymmetric trust per 2026-05-17 amendment)

observer_verification_history.description: Append-only chain of prior observer_verification snapshots that were superseded. Initial pending state is NOT logged; only real pass/fail attestations are. When set_observer_verification overwrites a prior real attestation, the prior is appended here with superseded_at and superseded_by fields.

approval_authority.note: approve_proposal() rejects approved_by='claude' on governance-category proposals. This preserves the meta-policy line: the recursion breaks at the human for constitutional changes.

publish_time_checks: source_url non-empty and resolves if filesystem path
approval_time_checks: observer_verification.status == 'pass' before approve_proposal or auto_approve_if_eligible can fire
scope_note: Heuristic-source proposals (source='heuristic') are unaffected. The rule applies only to autonomous-authored proposals (source startswith 'authored_by_').

governance_relevance_detection.description: Data-driven detector. If ANY of these signals match, the proposal is governance-relevant and shadow verification routes to bigbrain instead of Roux. Used by proposal_bus.is_governance_relevant().

amendment_note: Per META_POLICY.md, changes to this rule require human review through a governance-category proposal.
